svg.aria-label: A five-bar leg (cranks 100 mm, links 120 mm, ground 80 mm) moves its tip round a stride inside its reach, solved by sweep_fivebar_tip: its lowest transmission angle is 53.4° and its arms stay 68.8° from in line. Beside it, the map of the two crank angles shaded by transmission angle, with the stride's path; turning both cranks symmetrically from 90° locks at θ1 = 143.1°, where the links stretch into one line.

lowest transmission angle 53.4°, arms 68.8° from in line: a pass
The cranks: where the links close
Blank: the links cannot close. Under 40° a drive may bind.
